Let the AI Agent become a pixel employee, helping you write code in the office! 🤣

It can turn the Claude Code work status into cute pixel characters, directly creating an AI office in VS Code or a browser!

👨 💻 Each AI Agent has its own role and seat 
⌨️ Writing code, reading files, and executing instructions all have corresponding animations 
💬 When an AI gets stuck or needs authorization, the role will pop out as a prompt 
🏢 Free to arrange the office, furniture, and floor, and can even have pets 
🤖 Supports displaying Sub-agents and Agent Teams 
🌐 Provides VS Code extension packages and an independent CLI version

The most interesting thing is that when you run multiple Claude Code Agents at the same time, it's like running a mini software company, watching the employees busy! 😂

In the future, writing code is basically like playing a pixel-style management game! 
#ClaudeCode #AIAgent #OpenSource #VSCode #PixelArt

The most frustrating thing about making 2D games is not writing code, but the character animation has to be drawn one frame at a time.

Sharing a super useful open-source project: Agent Sprite Forge.

Just provide a character description, and the AI Agent can generate game-use character materials and animations.

🎨 AI-generated characters maintain consistent appearance for different actions.
🏃 Automatically generates animations for waiting, walking, running, attacking, etc.
🪄 Transforms videos into transparent background Sprite Sheets, PNG, GIFs.
🗺️ Supports generating 2D maps and pixel-style materials.
🎮 Can export Godot, Aseprite, and web game materials.
🤖 Supports Claude Code, Codex, Grok.

#AI #GameDev #PixelArt #OpenSource #ClaudeCode

就很希望未來能當個快樂的廚師，做著喜歡的工作。

但隨著年紀增長，發現海綿寶寶的生活不只令人嚮往

Line 群組裡面有個 Grok Bot 真的超方便

Bot 可以做到：
- 詢問大家方便聚餐的時間
- 找餐廳給大家選
- 選好餐廳後直接打開 inline 或 Open Table 網頁訂位
- 訂完位之後就順便建立行事曆
- 把行事曆連結丟回到群組

以前還要有個人當主揪
現在直接把主揪丟給 AI 來當就好
圖文版上架囉！

陪客戶做夢(O)
陪客戶做自動化(X)

最近對於 AI 模型的進步突然有感而發
五個月前，同一個客戶需求
用當時的 opus 只能跑出 6x% 的成功率

而現在只需要 sonnet 5.5 
就能跑出 99% 以上的成功率

這個場景是客戶流程的一大痛點
他們會收到一份超多頁的 pdf
以往都需要人工逐頁處理跟登打

現在因為他們導入了新的 ERP 系統
系統本身也能很簡單的就跟 AI 做串接
又享受到 AI 模型的進步

只需要在系統裡面做一部：上傳
接著就放手交給 AI + 系統處理
一個 PDF → 一百多筆資料 → 全自動出現在系統
同仁只需要確認那些 AI 回報信心程度較低的項目就好

一個小時的工作只剩下不到幾分鐘！
如果你想知道這是哪套 ERP 系統 ↓

歡迎洽詢 Odoo ERP 
找 @lupus_rr 評估自己的公司是否適合換成 Odoo

iPhone手機複製，Mac 直接貼上。
中間不用傳給Line了！！
​
這個功能叫「通用剪貼板」，
跟 AirDrop 一樣是蘋果內建的互通功能，
文字、圖片都能直接過去。
​
◼︎ 設定兩步
① iPhone：設定 → 一般 → AirPlay 與接續互動 → 打開 Handoff
② Mac：系統設定 → 一般 → AirDrop 與接續互動 → 打開接續互動
​
◼︎ 記得
✅ 兩台登入同一個 Apple ID
✅ 藍牙、Wi-Fi 都要開
